For us and all beings tormented by our karma, Wherever we dwell, when sickness, weapons, famine, and the like Repeatedly afflict us with countless unwanted sufferings, Please pull us from this mire of misery, O Jetsunma.

Conceptual thoughts following habitual tendencies are like ripples on water; In each and every instant, I accumulate many causes for the miserable realms. Of this never-ending seed of cyclic existence, Please cut the root right now, O Jetsunma.

Because the great accumulation of merit has not preceded this, Though I boast of having entered the gateway of the Victor’s teachings, My trust in the Three Jewels has not been firmly established; Please uproot these karmic obscurations, O Jetsunma.

Even when I see that the fruits of karma are ripening before my eyes, I still have not developed faith in karma and its results; Like a beast of prey in saffron robes, Please lead my mind toward virtue, O Jetsunma.

The human body, impermanent by day and night, moment by moment, Has been attained, yet the great purpose remains unaccomplished; The continuous noose of the Lord of Death, so difficult to turn back, Please sever with the sword of wisdom, O Jetsunma.
Even in the short term, from demons, epidemics, poisons, and weapons, From sudden death and base conditions, And from the eight and sixteen fears, Please protect me quickly, O Jetsunma.

As long as the stream of mind is habituated to the evil of self-grasping, For that long, the river of suffering will constantly flow; Therefore, regarding the nature of the aggregates and so forth, Please ignite the lamp of realization, O Jetsunma.

May I recognize all beings as my mothers, with love and compassion, Not just in words, but by truly exchanging the suffering of others With my own happiness; O Jetsunma, please cultivate in me The vast and great courage of those who do this.

In all my lifetimes, may I meet a spiritual friend who is not mistaken, And through them understand all the teachings; From now until enlightenment, O Jetsunma, please destroy The demonic forces that obstruct my life and liberation.

Possessing the eye of wisdom, free from the dust of profound insight, And the excellent conduct of one whose afflictions gradually diminish, With great respect for the training, and with mindfulness and vigilance, O Jetsunma, please blend my mind-stream with the Dharma.

When the momentum of my life finally reaches its end, Without fear, having realized the ten perceptions, Into the basic space free from the extremes of birth and cessation, O Jetsunma, please introduce me to the nature of clear light.

Even if the bardo appears for but a fleeting moment, May the emanation and reabsorption of the pure mandala be complete; In the Lotus Array of Great Bliss and other such realms, O Jetsunma, please lead me to a pure land.

Except for taking birth in existence through my own intention, May I not wander in cyclic existence by the power of karma; In the presence of the Victorious One of Infinite Life and Light, O Jetsunma, please prophesy my path and guide me forward.

Oceans of Buddhas, both those who have come and those yet to come, Hold the holy Dharma as their life-force in all infinite realms; O Jetsunma, please grant that my aspirations be fulfilled, Which teach the supreme conduct of awakening to perfection.

All the misdeeds, obscurations, faults, and downfalls accumulated since beginningless time, May they be purified and cleansed within this physical support; And until that time, grant me the glory of harmony with the Dharma, And the siddhi of deathless life-empowerment, O Jetsunma.

Even in dreams, may the supreme mind of awakening Not decline, and having completely abandoned all the works of Māra, May whatever I do with my three doors be a source That spreads benefit and happiness for the teachings and beings, O Jetsunma.

Having completely abandoned the distractions of the eight worldly concerns of this life, And without obstacles in the forests of the remote wilderness, By condensing the practice into its essence, in this very life, Make this human existence meaningful, O Jetsunma.

Through this suffering that I am currently experiencing, May the causes and effects of the suffering of all beings Be swiftly exhausted, and from now on, may I lead all beings, myself and others, From happiness to ever-greater happiness, O Jetsunma.

May the supreme teachings of the Victor, the source of benefit and happiness, Flourish and spread throughout the ten directions without ever declining, And may the lives of all those sublime great beings who uphold them Be extended for a long time, O Jetsunma.

In particular, the profound meaning of the essential definitive truth, May those with the good fortune to hear it have it settle in their ears; May the hosts of gods, nāgas, and yakṣas who delight in this, Raise its status to the very heights of heaven, O Jetsunma.

May the very name of unhappiness be absent throughout all lands, And may lifespan, merit, and glory flourish, with reverence for the teachings; From the great clouds of the jewel of a golden age of happiness, Let fall a rain of all that is desired, O Jetsunma.

For the sake of the Victor’s teachings and the happiness of sentient beings, May all the dense thickets of humans and non-humans Who engage in harmful thoughts and actions Be burned by the flames of your power and might, O Jetsunma.

May all mothers, vast as space, be free from the fears Of untimely death and the like, and naturally enjoy the glory of the ten virtues; May they accompany the foundation of the Three Jewels’ teachings, And steer the helm of liberation upward, O Jetsunma.

In particular, may I and those who depend upon me Never fall under the power of obstacles at any time; And may the pillar of life, firm and enduring, That perfects longevity and practice, be established, O Jetsunma.

O Deity in whom I have placed my trust for this life and the next, O Bhagavatī, who has become the Mother of the Victors of the three times, If you do not bring the fruits of my prayers to fruition, I have no other refuge, O Jetsunma.

By the power of the two accumulations gathered since beginningless time, You have attained an inconceivable body of space; Because I pray with one-pointed longing, Do not diminish your compassionate blessings, O Jetsunma.

Your body is the full autumn moon in the center of a lotus, The youthful bloom of vajra-bliss perfectly complete; With an infinite mandala of stainless light, Bestow the enlightened activities of the four rites, O Jetsunma.

With your palm that grants the supreme gift of fulfilling all wishes— Through which touching brings Dharma, wealth, desire, and liberation, And which is formed from a hundred merits— Anoint the crown of my head, O Jetsunma.

Upon the tip of the precious stem between the thumb and ring finger, From a lovely lotus that has newly blossomed, You pour forth nectar of every supreme and common kind; Bring delight to my mind, O Jetsunma.

Adorned with nets of pearls and small golden bells, Displaying the graceful play of divine ornaments and the like, Blazing with the majesty of molten gold at dawn, Appear before the eyes of my faith, O Jetsunma.

Supreme among those who grant rest in infinite realms, With a backdrop of the stainless, full moon, Seated in the indestructible vajra posture, Dwell as the ornament upon the crown of my head, O Jetsunma.

Proclaiming the Dharma with the profound melody of Brahmā, And teaching the vast, uninterrupted continuity, Sever all the webs of the three obscurations, And grant the relief of the throne of enlightenment, O Jetsunma.

With the precious vessel of your bodhicitta, O Tāre, From the ocean of suffering in cyclic existence and the lower realms, You constantly liberate all sentient beings, as vast as space; I prostrate to the Noble Mother, Jetsunma Drolma.
Homage to Tāre, the swift and heroic; To Tuttāre, she who dispels all fears; To Ture, the liberatress who grants all benefits; To the syllables of Svāhā, I bow to you.
Homage to Tārā, the swift and heroic, Whose eyes are like a momentary flash of lightning, She who arose from the opening stamens Of the lotus-face of the Lord of the Three Worlds.
Homage to her whose face is like A hundred full autumn moons gathered together, Blazing with the brilliant light Of a thousand gathered stars.
Homage to her whose hand is beautifully adorned With a gold and blue water-born lotus, She whose sphere of activity is generosity, diligence, austerity, peace, Patience, and meditative concentration.
Homage to the Uṣṇīṣa of the Tathāgatas, She who acts with infinite, complete victory, She who is deeply relied upon by the Victors' heirs, Having attained every single perfection without exception.
Homage to her who, with the syllables TUTTĀRA and HŪṂ, Fills the realms of desire, the directions, and space, Trampling the seven worlds under her feet, And is able to summon all without exception.
Homage to you, whom Indra, Agni, Brahmā, Vāyu, and the various Īśvaras worship, And whom spirits, zombies, gandharvas, And hosts of yakṣas praise from before you.

Homage to you who, with the syllables TRAṬ and PHAṬ, Completely shatter the magical wheels of adversaries, Trampling with your right leg drawn in and left extended, Blazing intensely amidst a swirling mass of fire.
Homage to TURE, the Great Fearful One, Who completely destroys the champions of Mara, Who forms a frowning expression upon your lotus face, And slays all enemies without exception.

Homage to her whose fingers, in the mudrā symbolizing the Three Jewels, Beautifully adorn her heart, Adorned with wheels in every direction without exception, Radiating a turbulent mass of her own brilliance.
Homage to you, majestic in your supreme joy, Who spread garlands of light as your crown ornament, Who, with the laughter of TUTTĀRE, Bring demons and the world under your power.
Homage to you, who have the power To summon all the hosts of local guardians, Who, with a vibrating frown and the syllable HŪṀ, Completely liberate from all destitution.
Homage to you, whose head is adorned with a crescent moon, Whose every ornament blazes intensely, From whose matted locks Amitābha Constantly radiates a magnificent light.
Homage to you, who dwell in the midst of a blazing garland, Like the fire at the end of an eon; With right leg extended and left bent, surrounded by joy, You completely destroy the armies of enemies.
Homage to you, who strike the surface of the earth With your palms and trample it with your feet; With a wrathful frown and the syllable HŪṀ, You shatter the seven levels.
Homage to you, blissful, virtuous, and peaceful, Whose very sphere of experience is the peace of nirvāṇa; Perfectly endowed with SVĀHĀ and OṀ, You are the one who destroys great negativity.
Homage to you, surrounded by intense joy, Who utterly shatters the bodies of enemies; With the ten-syllable mantra arranged on your speech, You are the wisdom-Tara arising from HŪṀ.
Homage to you, who stamp your feet with the syllable TURE, Whose essence is the seed-syllable in the form of HŪṀ; You cause Mount Meru, Mandara, and Vindhya, And all the three worlds to tremble.
Homage to you, who hold in your hand the deer-marked moon, Which has the form of a celestial lake; By reciting TĀRA twice and the syllable PHAT, You clear away every poison without exception.
Homage to you, the sovereign of the hosts of gods, Served by gods and kinnaras; With the majesty of your armor of universal joy, You dispel strife and bad dreams.
Homage to you, whose two eyes are as brilliant As the light of the full sun and moon; By reciting HARA twice and TUTTĀRE, You dispel the most violent contagious diseases.
Homage to you, perfectly endowed with the power of peace Through the arrangement of the three suchnesses; You are the supreme TURE who destroys The hosts of demons, zombies, and yakṣas.
Homage to Tārā!
Homage to all gurus, buddhas, and bodhisattvas.

More distinguished than the thousand buddhas of this fortunate aeon, Noble and wondrous as the uḍumbara flower, You who took hold of this realm during this age of strife, Homage to the Supreme Sage, the Fulfiller of All Aims.
With the crowns of gods and demigods, Bowing down before your lotus feet, To you who liberate from all misfortune, Mother Tārā, I offer this homage.

Chokgyur Dechen Lingpa, who opened the door to profound treasures, Dorje Ziji Tsal, endowed with the seven authoritative transmissions, Pema Garwang, who clarified the Buddha’s teachings, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!

The Buddha's teachings of the Vinaya, Sūtra, and Abhidharma, Along with the four great classes of the Secret Mantra Tantras, The ten great pillars of the scriptural lineages in the Land of Snows, And the eight great chariots of the practice lineages, and so forth— Behold how all the systems of the Buddha’s teachings, both Sūtra and Mantra, Have now fallen into a state of extreme decline!

Sentient beings of this degenerate age, when the five drosses are rampant, Are bound by the powerful force of afflictions and the shackles of craving. Those who have entered the teachings are driven by the red wind of jealousy; The teachings are agitated from within, and the dregs of degenerate views flourish.

Because it has become an age of contention, the pollution of those who undermine the teachings Causes the Dharma protectors and guardians of the virtuous side to become indifferent. Throughout every land, asuras and barbarians abound. Through these and similar circumstances, the teachings are being destroyed.

Since you are lords of the ten strengths and possess the ten masteries, Restore these declining teachings to their original state, And may those who are authoritative, learned, disciplined, and accomplished, Manifest in many forms to restore the teachings.
In both India and Tibet, may the precious lamp Of the festival of a later golden age be lit, And may the lotus grove of the Buddha's non-sectarian teachings reach its full bloom.

May the minds of the hostile throngs be transformed, And may all aspire to the teachings and engage in the ten virtues. May the Sangha who uphold the teachings pervade the entire world, And may study and practice flourish and spread.

May the temples be filled with vast clouds of offerings, And the great drum of the sacred Dharma resound loudly. Shattering the skulls of the heretical elephants, May the Buddha’s teachings be victorious in all directions!

May the lives of the masters who uphold the teachings be firm, And may the lifespan and merit of the patrons of the teachings increase. May those who harm the teachings be reduced to nothing but their names, And may the victory banner of the teachings be raised in the ten directions!
When the protector of beings was first born, All the wise ones of the world rejoiced; The hosts of Māra were filled with great anxiety, And all the non-Buddhist extremists were terrified.

Having attained supreme enlightenment, Your work for the sake of beings is truly wondrous; That you sacrificed your own life Before being freed from the craving of existence makes my hair stand on end.
Thus, the Guru of beings, of the Śākya lineage, Born from the royal line of the Ikṣvāku, By this praise of the Bhagavan, the Perfect Buddha, May beings swiftly attain omniscience.

Mother of all the Victors, medicine that dispels torment, Loving nurse, the sole kinsman of all living beings; Throughout the garland of my lives, I have no other, So I take refuge in you until I reach the heart of enlightenment.

With Ture, the very moment one remembers your feet, Through your display of names and forms to tame beings according to their needs, You protect from all the misfortunes of the view of self; I prostrate to the Mother, the Swift and Compassionate One.

Svāhā! With clouds of the perfect age of enlightened activity, You let fall a rain of the jewels of virtue and excellence, Granting relief to all beings of the three realms; I prostrate to the Mother, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

With the stainless, precious vessel of your compassion, You rescue beings from the ocean of existence and peace, And grant relief in the city of the heart of enlightenment; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

In short, for the sake of fully perfecting The compassionate resolve and sacred vows of all who possess the ten powers, You perform inconceivable deeds to tame beings, I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.
Since merely hearing your name Liberates beings from the ocean of cyclic existence, My mind is captivated by this wonder alone, And with single-pointed devotion, I pray to you.

Those who have entered the teachings are driven by the red wind of jealousy; The teachings are agitated from within, and the dregs of degenerate views flourish.

This captivating food, endowed with a hundred flavors, Is perfectly prepared and offered with faith to the Victors and their Heirs; Through this, may all these wandering beings Possess great wealth and enjoy the food of meditative concentration.
I prostrate with devotion to the Guru and Mañjughoṣa.

You have perfectly accomplished generosity and ethical discipline, And practiced patience and diligence; Having reached the culmination of meditative concentration and wisdom, I prostrate to you, who have perfected the perfections.
Because you have attained in every way The phenomena as they are and as they exist, I prostrate to you, who have accomplished The enlightened activities as you intended.
I prostrate, make offerings, and confess, I rejoice, exhort, and pray; Whatever slight virtue I have accumulated, I dedicate it all for the sake of enlightenment.

With Oṃ, you bestow the wealth of liberation and all that is desired, Through the good fortune of splendor, prosperity, and the like; You benefit both cyclic existence and peace, O Sovereign of the Three Secrets, I prostrate to the Noble Mother, the Supreme Giver.

With the precious vessel of your bodhicitta, O Tāre, From the ocean of suffering in cyclic existence and the lower realms, You constantly liberate all sentient beings, as vast as space; I prostrate to the Noble Mother, Jetsunma Drolma.

With Tuttāre, the nectar of blessings, You dispel the tormenting heat of fears and decline, And cause the lotus of benefit and happiness to bloom; I prostrate to the Mother, the Protectress from Distress.

With Ture, the very moment one remembers your feet, Through your display of names and forms to tame beings according to their needs, You protect from all the misfortunes of the view of self; I prostrate to the Mother, the Swift and Compassionate One.

With the stainless, precious vessel of your compassion, You rescue beings from the ocean of existence and peace, And grant relief in the city of the heart of enlightenment; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

You are the supreme essence churned from the ocean of the two accumulations; By the mere arising of your moon-like form of marks and signs in the mind, You grant the respite of longevity and primordial wisdom; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

From the singular lapis lazuli lute of your secret speech, The ocean of melodic branches, like music, Arises fully as the radiance of ten million Dharma-heaps; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Your heart-mind is the expanse of non-dual primordial wisdom; Though you have withdrawn the engagement and emergence of conceptual elaborations, You possess boundless splendor of awareness and love; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Possessing the grace of the sixty-four inexhaustible qualities, Of both abandonment and full maturation, You are the Mother who captivates all the Victors and their heirs; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Constant in continuity and all-pervading like space, Through spontaneously accomplished enlightened activity, You fulfill the hopes of those to be trained, O Lord of the Wish-Fulfilling Tree; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

In short, for the sake of fully perfecting The compassionate resolve and sacred vows of all who possess the ten powers, You perform inconceivable deeds to tame beings, I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Thus, with devotion I prostrate and make this supplication: From the great clouds of your wisdom-vision, perfect and complete, Let the rain of all desired accomplishments fall, And grant your blessings so that the festival of benefit and happiness may flourish.

From the ocean of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion, The glory of the blooming lotus of benefit and bliss has arisen; Noble Tārā, possessing the light of nectar, Please pacify these waves of darkness filled with fear.

The profound and supremely peaceful expanse, Completely free from directions and partiality— In the moment of your blessing, Please cause subject and object to dissolve into the central channel.
Therefore, reaching out your hand of compassion, Please dispel every fear, And grant me the good fortune Of finding relief in a state of supreme bliss.

Those who bear the victory banner of saffron robes and the discipline of renunciation, Bodhisattvas who possess genuine, unfeigned altruism, And mantra-holders of the generation and completion stages who maintain their samaya— To those who have become like a painted lamp, You who possess the eye of primordial wisdom, Please look upon us with certainty and protect us with your compassion!
For the sake of others, With perfect intention and application, When you generated the mind for supreme enlightenment, The earth trembled in six ways.

Having attained supreme enlightenment, Your work for the sake of beings is truly wondrous; That you sacrificed your own life Before being freed from the craving of existence makes my hair stand on end.
Your son is Mañjughoṣa, Your disciple is Śāradvatīputra, You have made Maitreya your supreme regent; Who could possibly doubt this?
Dharmakāya Prajñāpāramitā, Bhagavatī Samantabhadrī, Complete Sambhogakāya Vajravārāhī, Emanation-display, the Venerable Mother Tārā, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!

Having attained supreme enlightenment, Your work for the sake of beings is truly wondrous; That you sacrificed your own life Before being freed from the craving of existence makes my hair stand on end.
Seeing such excellent deeds, And aspiring for your qualities, I enter upon the path for the sake of enlightenment; Once again, I take refuge in you.
I prostrate, make offerings, and confess, I rejoice, exhort, and pray; Whatever slight virtue I have accumulated, I dedicate it all for the sake of enlightenment.

Therefore, your teaching Possesses enlightened activity like the light of the sun; To you, the unerring kinsman in every respect, I go for refuge.

Homage to Tārā, the swift and heroic, Whose eyes are like a momentary flash of lightning, She who arose from the opening stamens Of the lotus-face of the Lord of the Three Worlds.
Homage to her whose face is like A hundred full autumn moons gathered together, Blazing with the brilliant light Of a thousand gathered stars.
Homage to you, who dwell in the midst of a blazing garland, Like the fire at the end of an eon; With right leg extended and left bent, surrounded by joy, You completely destroy the armies of enemies.

For us and all beings tormented by our karma, Wherever we dwell, when sickness, weapons, famine, and the like Repeatedly afflict us with countless unwanted sufferings, Please pull us from this mire of misery, O Jetsunma.

Conceptual thoughts following habitual tendencies are like ripples on water; In each and every instant, I accumulate many causes for the miserable realms. Of this never-ending seed of cyclic existence, Please cut the root right now, O Jetsunma.

Even when I see that the fruits of karma are ripening before my eyes, I still have not developed faith in karma and its results; Like a beast of prey in saffron robes, Please lead my mind toward virtue, O Jetsunma.

May all mothers, vast as space, be free from the fears Of untimely death and the like, and naturally enjoy the glory of the ten virtues; May they accompany the foundation of the Three Jewels’ teachings, And steer the helm of liberation upward, O Jetsunma.

Adorned with nets of pearls and small golden bells, Displaying the graceful play of divine ornaments and the like, Blazing with the majesty of molten gold at dawn, Appear before the eyes of my faith, O Jetsunma.

With Oṃ, you bestow the wealth of liberation and all that is desired, Through the good fortune of splendor, prosperity, and the like; You benefit both cyclic existence and peace, O Sovereign of the Three Secrets, I prostrate to the Noble Mother, the Supreme Giver.

From the singular lapis lazuli lute of your secret speech, The ocean of melodic branches, like music, Arises fully as the radiance of ten million Dharma-heaps; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Constant in continuity and all-pervading like space, Through spontaneously accomplished enlightened activity, You fulfill the hopes of those to be trained, O Lord of the Wish-Fulfilling Tree; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Those who bear the victory banner of saffron robes and the discipline of renunciation, Bodhisattvas who possess genuine, unfeigned altruism, And mantra-holders of the generation and completion stages who maintain their samaya— To those who have become like a painted lamp, You who possess the eye of primordial wisdom, Please look upon us with certainty and protect us with your compassion!

Having attained supreme enlightenment, Your work for the sake of beings is truly wondrous; That you sacrificed your own life Before being freed from the craving of existence makes my hair stand on end.

Except for taking birth in existence through my own intention, May I not wander in cyclic existence by the power of karma; In the presence of the Victorious One of Infinite Life and Light, O Jetsunma, please prophesy my path and guide me forward.

Having completely abandoned the distractions of the eight worldly concerns of this life, And without obstacles in the forests of the remote wilderness, By condensing the practice into its essence, in this very life, Make this human existence meaningful, O Jetsunma.

With Oṃ, you bestow the wealth of liberation and all that is desired, Through the good fortune of splendor, prosperity, and the like; You benefit both cyclic existence and peace, O Sovereign of the Three Secrets, I prostrate to the Noble Mother, the Supreme Giver.

With the precious vessel of your bodhicitta, O Tāre, From the ocean of suffering in cyclic existence and the lower realms, You constantly liberate all sentient beings, as vast as space; I prostrate to the Noble Mother, Jetsunma Drolma.

With the stainless, precious vessel of your compassion, You rescue beings from the ocean of existence and peace, And grant relief in the city of the heart of enlightenment; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.
Since merely hearing your name Liberates beings from the ocean of cyclic existence, My mind is captivated by this wonder alone, And with single-pointed devotion, I pray to you.

You have perfectly accomplished generosity and ethical discipline, And practiced patience and diligence; Having reached the culmination of meditative concentration and wisdom, I prostrate to you, who have perfected the perfections.

May the field of my mind be moistened by the spirit of renunciation, May the sprouts of pure, altruistic intention grow in lush rows, And bearing the abundant fruit of great primordial wisdom, I pray that you grant the spontaneous accomplishment of the twofold benefit!

The human body, impermanent by day and night, moment by moment, Has been attained, yet the great purpose remains unaccomplished; The continuous noose of the Lord of Death, so difficult to turn back, Please sever with the sword of wisdom, O Jetsunma.

Possessing the eye of wisdom, free from the dust of profound insight, And the excellent conduct of one whose afflictions gradually diminish, With great respect for the training, and with mindfulness and vigilance, O Jetsunma, please blend my mind-stream with the Dharma.

In brief, to you, the Noble Lady, who is the single embodiment Of the primordial wisdom of all the Victors and their heirs, I pray with heartfelt devotion: Hold me in your care until I reach enlightenment.

You are the supreme essence churned from the ocean of the two accumulations; By the mere arising of your moon-like form of marks and signs in the mind, You grant the respite of longevity and primordial wisdom; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

The Buddha's teachings of the Vinaya, Sūtra, and Abhidharma, Along with the four great classes of the Secret Mantra Tantras, The ten great pillars of the scriptural lineages in the Land of Snows, And the eight great chariots of the practice lineages, and so forth— Behold how all the systems of the Buddha’s teachings, both Sūtra and Mantra, Have now fallen into a state of extreme decline!

Since you are lords of the ten strengths and possess the ten masteries, Restore these declining teachings to their original state, And may those who are authoritative, learned, disciplined, and accomplished, Manifest in many forms to restore the teachings.

May the minds of the hostile throngs be transformed, And may all aspire to the teachings and engage in the ten virtues. May the Sangha who uphold the teachings pervade the entire world, And may study and practice flourish and spread.

Especially for those of us terrified by the decay of these times, Which are the most degenerate of the degenerate, O Mother of the Victors, day and night, I have no thought of any refuge other than you.

This captivating food, endowed with a hundred flavors, Is perfectly prepared and offered with faith to the Victors and their Heirs; Through this, may all these wandering beings Possess great wealth and enjoy the food of meditative concentration.

May the temples be filled with vast clouds of offerings, And the great drum of the sacred Dharma resound loudly. Shattering the skulls of the heretical elephants, May the Buddha’s teachings be victorious in all directions!

May the lives of the masters who uphold the teachings be firm, And may the lifespan and merit of the patrons of the teachings increase. May those who harm the teachings be reduced to nothing but their names, And may the victory banner of the teachings be raised in the ten directions!
For the sake of others, With perfect intention and application, When you generated the mind for supreme enlightenment, The earth trembled in six ways.

Having attained supreme enlightenment, Your work for the sake of beings is truly wondrous; That you sacrificed your own life Before being freed from the craving of existence makes my hair stand on end.
Seeing such excellent deeds, And aspiring for your qualities, I enter upon the path for the sake of enlightenment; Once again, I take refuge in you.
I prostrate, make offerings, and confess, I rejoice, exhort, and pray; Whatever slight virtue I have accumulated, I dedicate it all for the sake of enlightenment.

For the sake of the Victor’s teachings and the happiness of sentient beings, May all the dense thickets of humans and non-humans Who engage in harmful thoughts and actions Be burned by the flames of your power and might, O Jetsunma.

In short, for the sake of fully perfecting The compassionate resolve and sacred vows of all who possess the ten powers, You perform inconceivable deeds to tame beings, I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

You have perfectly accomplished generosity and ethical discipline, And practiced patience and diligence; Having reached the culmination of meditative concentration and wisdom, I prostrate to you, who have perfected the perfections.
Because you have attained in every way The phenomena as they are and as they exist, I prostrate to you, who have accomplished The enlightened activities as you intended.

Pacify all adverse conditions for practicing the sublime Dharma, And with the perfect abundance of all favorable conditions— Lifespan, merit, prosperity, intelligence, and compassion— Grant your blessings so that the two benefits may be accomplished.

Constant in continuity and all-pervading like space, Through spontaneously accomplished enlightened activity, You fulfill the hopes of those to be trained, O Lord of the Wish-Fulfilling Tree; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Since you are lords of the ten strengths and possess the ten masteries, Restore these declining teachings to their original state, And may those who are authoritative, learned, disciplined, and accomplished, Manifest in many forms to restore the teachings.

May the very name of unhappiness be absent throughout all lands, And may lifespan, merit, and glory flourish, with reverence for the teachings; From the great clouds of the jewel of a golden age of happiness, Let fall a rain of all that is desired, O Jetsunma.

More distinguished than the thousand buddhas of this fortunate aeon, Noble and wondrous as the uḍumbara flower, You who took hold of this realm during this age of strife, Homage to the Supreme Sage, the Fulfiller of All Aims.

Your body is the full autumn moon in the center of a lotus, The youthful bloom of vajra-bliss perfectly complete; With an infinite mandala of stainless light, Bestow the enlightened activities of the four rites, O Jetsunma.

With Tuttāre, the nectar of blessings, You dispel the tormenting heat of fears and decline, And cause the lotus of benefit and happiness to bloom; I prostrate to the Mother, the Protectress from Distress.
Furthermore, may the flowers of the fourfold perfections bloom in beauty for the time being, And ultimately, I pray that you grant the ripening fruit Of the union of the indivisible three kāyas.
In both India and Tibet, may the precious lamp Of the festival of a later golden age be lit, And may the lotus grove of the Buddha's non-sectarian teachings reach its full bloom.
Homage to you, who stamp your feet with the syllable TURE, Whose essence is the seed-syllable in the form of HŪṀ; You cause Mount Meru, Mandara, and Vindhya, And all the three worlds to tremble.

Having completely abandoned the distractions of the eight worldly concerns of this life, And without obstacles in the forests of the remote wilderness, By condensing the practice into its essence, in this very life, Make this human existence meaningful, O Jetsunma.
In short, since you are the essence of refuge, Until I attain enlightenment, always Do not let me fall under the power of obstructing demons, But grant your grace to perfect the twofold benefit.

You are the supreme essence churned from the ocean of the two accumulations; By the mere arising of your moon-like form of marks and signs in the mind, You grant the respite of longevity and primordial wisdom; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

From the ocean of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion, The glory of the blooming lotus of benefit and bliss has arisen; Noble Tārā, possessing the light of nectar, Please pacify these waves of darkness filled with fear.

All the misdeeds, obscurations, faults, and downfalls accumulated since beginningless time, May they be purified and cleansed within this physical support; And until that time, grant me the glory of harmony with the Dharma, And the siddhi of deathless life-empowerment, O Jetsunma.

May the very name of unhappiness be absent throughout all lands, And may lifespan, merit, and glory flourish, with reverence for the teachings; From the great clouds of the jewel of a golden age of happiness, Let fall a rain of all that is desired, O Jetsunma.

May all mothers, vast as space, be free from the fears Of untimely death and the like, and naturally enjoy the glory of the ten virtues; May they accompany the foundation of the Three Jewels’ teachings, And steer the helm of liberation upward, O Jetsunma.
Homage to you, the sovereign of the hosts of gods, Served by gods and kinnaras; With the majesty of your armor of universal joy, You dispel strife and bad dreams.
Homage to you, whose two eyes are as brilliant As the light of the full sun and moon; By reciting HARA twice and TUTTĀRE, You dispel the most violent contagious diseases.

With Tuttāre, the nectar of blessings, You dispel the tormenting heat of fears and decline, And cause the lotus of benefit and happiness to bloom; I prostrate to the Mother, the Protectress from Distress.
Therefore, reaching out your hand of compassion, Please dispel every fear, And grant me the good fortune Of finding relief in a state of supreme bliss.
Homage to you, majestic in your supreme joy, Who spread garlands of light as your crown ornament, Who, with the laughter of TUTTĀRE, Bring demons and the world under your power.
Homage to you, who dwell in the midst of a blazing garland, Like the fire at the end of an eon; With right leg extended and left bent, surrounded by joy, You completely destroy the armies of enemies.
Homage to you, surrounded by intense joy, Who utterly shatters the bodies of enemies; With the ten-syllable mantra arranged on your speech, You are the wisdom-Tara arising from HŪṀ.
Homage to you, the sovereign of the hosts of gods, Served by gods and kinnaras; With the majesty of your armor of universal joy, You dispel strife and bad dreams.
Homage to all gurus, buddhas, and bodhisattvas.

Buddhas, bodhisattvas, śrāvakas, and pratyekabuddhas of the ten directions, Mañjuśrī, Avalokiteśvara, and the Holder of the Vajra, Bodhisattvas such as Maitreya and the rest, The sixteen elders and the seven great successors.

Those who bear the victory banner of saffron robes and the discipline of renunciation, Bodhisattvas who possess genuine, unfeigned altruism, And mantra-holders of the generation and completion stages who maintain their samaya— To those who have become like a painted lamp, You who possess the eye of primordial wisdom, Please look upon us with certainty and protect us with your compassion!

Homage to her whose fingers, in the mudrā symbolizing the Three Jewels, Beautifully adorn her heart, Adorned with wheels in every direction without exception, Radiating a turbulent mass of her own brilliance.

Because the great accumulation of merit has not preceded this, Though I boast of having entered the gateway of the Victor’s teachings, My trust in the Three Jewels has not been firmly established; Please uproot these karmic obscurations, O Jetsunma.

May all mothers, vast as space, be free from the fears Of untimely death and the like, and naturally enjoy the glory of the ten virtues; May they accompany the foundation of the Three Jewels’ teachings, And steer the helm of liberation upward, O Jetsunma.

Svāhā! With clouds of the perfect age of enlightened activity, You let fall a rain of the jewels of virtue and excellence, Granting relief to all beings of the three realms; I prostrate to the Mother, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Chokgyur Dechen Lingpa, who opened the door to profound treasures, Dorje Ziji Tsal, endowed with the seven authoritative transmissions, Pema Garwang, who clarified the Buddha’s teachings, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!
Homage to you, blissful, virtuous, and peaceful, Whose very sphere of experience is the peace of nirvāṇa; Perfectly endowed with SVĀHĀ and OṀ, You are the one who destroys great negativity.
Homage to you, perfectly endowed with the power of peace Through the arrangement of the three suchnesses; You are the supreme TURE who destroys The hosts of demons, zombies, and yakṣas.

This captivating food, endowed with a hundred flavors, Is perfectly prepared and offered with faith to the Victors and their Heirs; Through this, may all these wandering beings Possess great wealth and enjoy the food of meditative concentration.
When the protector of beings was first born, All the wise ones of the world rejoiced; The hosts of Māra were filled with great anxiety, And all the non-Buddhist extremists were terrified.
Without regarding your own life, Saying, "I shall act for your benefit," You cared for us who were without a protector; O Protector, I take refuge in you.
Alas! O compassionate Protector, Exert the power and might of your sacred vows, Why would you ever be discouraged by the sorrows of these degenerate times?

By the power of the two accumulations gathered since beginningless time, You have attained an inconceivable body of space; Because I pray with one-pointed longing, Do not diminish your compassionate blessings, O Jetsunma.

With Tuttāre, the nectar of blessings, You dispel the tormenting heat of fears and decline, And cause the lotus of benefit and happiness to bloom; I prostrate to the Mother, the Protectress from Distress.

Pacify all adverse conditions for practicing the sublime Dharma, And with the perfect abundance of all favorable conditions— Lifespan, merit, prosperity, intelligence, and compassion— Grant your blessings so that the two benefits may be accomplished.

Thus, with devotion I prostrate and make this supplication: From the great clouds of your wisdom-vision, perfect and complete, Let the rain of all desired accomplishments fall, And grant your blessings so that the festival of benefit and happiness may flourish.

From the ocean of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion, The glory of the blooming lotus of benefit and bliss has arisen; Noble Tārā, possessing the light of nectar, Please pacify these waves of darkness filled with fear.

Possessing the eye of wisdom, free from the dust of profound insight, And the excellent conduct of one whose afflictions gradually diminish, With great respect for the training, and with mindfulness and vigilance, O Jetsunma, please blend my mind-stream with the Dharma.

Possessing the grace of the sixty-four inexhaustible qualities, Of both abandonment and full maturation, You are the Mother who captivates all the Victors and their heirs; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.
Possessing the auspicious signs of millions of most beautiful emerald particles Gathered into one, May your beautiful form play before my eyes, Radiant with a hundred moods of peaceful smiles.

Oceans of Buddhas, both those who have come and those yet to come, Hold the holy Dharma as their life-force in all infinite realms; O Jetsunma, please grant that my aspirations be fulfilled, Which teach the supreme conduct of awakening to perfection.
Homage to all gurus, buddhas, and bodhisattvas.

More distinguished than the thousand buddhas of this fortunate aeon, Noble and wondrous as the uḍumbara flower, You who took hold of this realm during this age of strife, Homage to the Supreme Sage, the Fulfiller of All Aims.

Buddhas, bodhisattvas, śrāvakas, and pratyekabuddhas of the ten directions, Mañjuśrī, Avalokiteśvara, and the Holder of the Vajra, Bodhisattvas such as Maitreya and the rest, The sixteen elders and the seven great successors.
Homage to you, who have the power To summon all the hosts of local guardians, Who, with a vibrating frown and the syllable HŪṀ, Completely liberate from all destitution.
Homage to you, who strike the surface of the earth With your palms and trample it with your feet; With a wrathful frown and the syllable HŪṀ, You shatter the seven levels.
Homage to you, who stamp your feet with the syllable TURE, Whose essence is the seed-syllable in the form of HŪṀ; You cause Mount Meru, Mandara, and Vindhya, And all the three worlds to tremble.
Homage to you, who hold in your hand the deer-marked moon, Which has the form of a celestial lake; By reciting TĀRA twice and the syllable PHAT, You clear away every poison without exception.
I prostrate with devotion to the Guru and Mañjughoṣa.

In brief, to you, the Noble Lady, who is the single embodiment Of the primordial wisdom of all the Victors and their heirs, I pray with heartfelt devotion: Hold me in your care until I reach enlightenment.

Thus, with devotion I prostrate and make this supplication: From the great clouds of your wisdom-vision, perfect and complete, Let the rain of all desired accomplishments fall, And grant your blessings so that the festival of benefit and happiness may flourish.
Since merely hearing your name Liberates beings from the ocean of cyclic existence, My mind is captivated by this wonder alone, And with single-pointed devotion, I pray to you.
The second Buddha, Padmākara, Lord of a hundred thousand ḍākinīs, holder of the secret mantra treasury, Bodhisattva Prince Rolpa Tsal, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!
Homage to you, surrounded by intense joy, Who utterly shatters the bodies of enemies; With the ten-syllable mantra arranged on your speech, You are the wisdom-Tara arising from HŪṀ.

The Buddha's teachings of the Vinaya, Sūtra, and Abhidharma, Along with the four great classes of the Secret Mantra Tantras, The ten great pillars of the scriptural lineages in the Land of Snows, And the eight great chariots of the practice lineages, and so forth— Behold how all the systems of the Buddha’s teachings, both Sūtra and Mantra, Have now fallen into a state of extreme decline!

By the power of the two accumulations gathered since beginningless time, You have attained an inconceivable body of space; Because I pray with one-pointed longing, Do not diminish your compassionate blessings, O Jetsunma.

With Ture, the very moment one remembers your feet, Through your display of names and forms to tame beings according to their needs, You protect from all the misfortunes of the view of self; I prostrate to the Mother, the Swift and Compassionate One.

In short, for the sake of fully perfecting The compassionate resolve and sacred vows of all who possess the ten powers, You perform inconceivable deeds to tame beings, I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.
Alas! O compassionate Protector, Exert the power and might of your sacred vows, Why would you ever be discouraged by the sorrows of these degenerate times?
Homage to you, majestic in your supreme joy, Who spread garlands of light as your crown ornament, Who, with the laughter of TUTTĀRE, Bring demons and the world under your power.
Homage to you, perfectly endowed with the power of peace Through the arrangement of the three suchnesses; You are the supreme TURE who destroys The hosts of demons, zombies, and yakṣas.
Even in the short term, from demons, epidemics, poisons, and weapons, From sudden death and base conditions, And from the eight and sixteen fears, Please protect me quickly, O Jetsunma.
In short, since you are the essence of refuge, Until I attain enlightenment, always Do not let me fall under the power of obstructing demons, But grant your grace to perfect the twofold benefit.

For us and all beings tormented by our karma, Wherever we dwell, when sickness, weapons, famine, and the like Repeatedly afflict us with countless unwanted sufferings, Please pull us from this mire of misery, O Jetsunma.

Even when I see that the fruits of karma are ripening before my eyes, I still have not developed faith in karma and its results; Like a beast of prey in saffron robes, Please lead my mind toward virtue, O Jetsunma.

Except for taking birth in existence through my own intention, May I not wander in cyclic existence by the power of karma; In the presence of the Victorious One of Infinite Life and Light, O Jetsunma, please prophesy my path and guide me forward.
The second Buddha, Padmākara, Lord of a hundred thousand ḍākinīs, holder of the secret mantra treasury, Bodhisattva Prince Rolpa Tsal, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!
Homage to her whose face is like A hundred full autumn moons gathered together, Blazing with the brilliant light Of a thousand gathered stars.

With your palm that grants the supreme gift of fulfilling all wishes— Through which touching brings Dharma, wealth, desire, and liberation, And which is formed from a hundred merits— Anoint the crown of my head, O Jetsunma.
Possessing the auspicious signs of millions of most beautiful emerald particles Gathered into one, May your beautiful form play before my eyes, Radiant with a hundred moods of peaceful smiles.

This captivating food, endowed with a hundred flavors, Is perfectly prepared and offered with faith to the Victors and their Heirs; Through this, may all these wandering beings Possess great wealth and enjoy the food of meditative concentration.

As long as the stream of mind is habituated to the evil of self-grasping, For that long, the river of suffering will constantly flow; Therefore, regarding the nature of the aggregates and so forth, Please ignite the lamp of realization, O Jetsunma.

Upon the tip of the precious stem between the thumb and ring finger, From a lovely lotus that has newly blossomed, You pour forth nectar of every supreme and common kind; Bring delight to my mind, O Jetsunma.

The five Sakya patriarchs, Marpa, Milarepa, and Gampopa, Mañjughoṣa Lama and all the other Indian and Tibetan Assemblies of learned and accomplished vidyādharas, The peaceful and wrathful yidams, ḍākinīs, dharma protectors, and so forth— I invoke you from the depths of your heart; look upon us with your compassion!

Homage to Tārā, the swift and heroic, Whose eyes are like a momentary flash of lightning, She who arose from the opening stamens Of the lotus-face of the Lord of the Three Worlds.
Homage to her who, with the syllables TUTTĀRA and HŪṂ, Fills the realms of desire, the directions, and space, Trampling the seven worlds under her feet, And is able to summon all without exception.
Homage to you, who stamp your feet with the syllable TURE, Whose essence is the seed-syllable in the form of HŪṀ; You cause Mount Meru, Mandara, and Vindhya, And all the three worlds to tremble.

Of the mundane and the supramundane, The precious treasure of the ocean of accomplishments, Through the attainment of the secret vidyā-mantra, May you bestow benefit and happiness upon the three worlds.

Upon the tip of the precious stem between the thumb and ring finger, From a lovely lotus that has newly blossomed, You pour forth nectar of every supreme and common kind; Bring delight to my mind, O Jetsunma.

With the precious vessel of your bodhicitta, O Tāre, From the ocean of suffering in cyclic existence and the lower realms, You constantly liberate all sentient beings, as vast as space; I prostrate to the Noble Mother, Jetsunma Drolma.

With the stainless, precious vessel of your compassion, You rescue beings from the ocean of existence and peace, And grant relief in the city of the heart of enlightenment; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Of the mundane and the supramundane, The precious treasure of the ocean of accomplishments, Through the attainment of the secret vidyā-mantra, May you bestow benefit and happiness upon the three worlds.
In both India and Tibet, may the precious lamp Of the festival of a later golden age be lit, And may the lotus grove of the Buddha's non-sectarian teachings reach its full bloom.

May I recognize all beings as my mothers, with love and compassion, Not just in words, but by truly exchanging the suffering of others With my own happiness; O Jetsunma, please cultivate in me The vast and great courage of those who do this.

Through this suffering that I am currently experiencing, May the causes and effects of the suffering of all beings Be swiftly exhausted, and from now on, may I lead all beings, myself and others, From happiness to ever-greater happiness, O Jetsunma.

With the precious vessel of your bodhicitta, O Tāre, From the ocean of suffering in cyclic existence and the lower realms, You constantly liberate all sentient beings, as vast as space; I prostrate to the Noble Mother, Jetsunma Drolma.
Homage to the Uṣṇīṣa of the Tathāgatas, She who acts with infinite, complete victory, She who is deeply relied upon by the Victors' heirs, Having attained every single perfection without exception.
Homage to her who, with the syllables TUTTĀRA and HŪṂ, Fills the realms of desire, the directions, and space, Trampling the seven worlds under her feet, And is able to summon all without exception.
Homage to TURE, the Great Fearful One, Who completely destroys the champions of Mara, Who forms a frowning expression upon your lotus face, And slays all enemies without exception.

Homage to her whose fingers, in the mudrā symbolizing the Three Jewels, Beautifully adorn her heart, Adorned with wheels in every direction without exception, Radiating a turbulent mass of her own brilliance.
Homage to you, who hold in your hand the deer-marked moon, Which has the form of a celestial lake; By reciting TĀRA twice and the syllable PHAT, You clear away every poison without exception.
Homage to you, blissful, virtuous, and peaceful, Whose very sphere of experience is the peace of nirvāṇa; Perfectly endowed with SVĀHĀ and OṀ, You are the one who destroys great negativity.

The profound and supremely peaceful expanse, Completely free from directions and partiality— In the moment of your blessing, Please cause subject and object to dissolve into the central channel.

May the temples be filled with vast clouds of offerings, And the great drum of the sacred Dharma resound loudly. Shattering the skulls of the heretical elephants, May the Buddha’s teachings be victorious in all directions!

Beneath the sovereign Bodhi tree, you pervaded the earth and sky, subduing the hosts of Māra, Who rained down a shower of vajras, short spears, wheels, fire, mountains, and ranges of snow-peaks. When the powerful one, adorned with flower-arrows, strove to obstruct your enlightenment through miraculous displays, You defeated them well with a heart of loving-kindness; I bow my head to you, the one who attained perfect Buddhahood.

Homage to her whose fingers, in the mudrā symbolizing the Three Jewels, Beautifully adorn her heart, Adorned with wheels in every direction without exception, Radiating a turbulent mass of her own brilliance.

Mother of all the Victors, medicine that dispels torment, Loving nurse, the sole kinsman of all living beings; Throughout the garland of my lives, I have no other, So I take refuge in you until I reach the heart of enlightenment.

With the stainless, precious vessel of your compassion, You rescue beings from the ocean of existence and peace, And grant relief in the city of the heart of enlightenment; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

May the lives of the masters who uphold the teachings be firm, And may the lifespan and merit of the patrons of the teachings increase. May those who harm the teachings be reduced to nothing but their names, And may the victory banner of the teachings be raised in the ten directions!

With Oṃ, you bestow the wealth of liberation and all that is desired, Through the good fortune of splendor, prosperity, and the like; You benefit both cyclic existence and peace, O Sovereign of the Three Secrets, I prostrate to the Noble Mother, the Supreme Giver.

Thus, with devotion I prostrate and make this supplication: From the great clouds of your wisdom-vision, perfect and complete, Let the rain of all desired accomplishments fall, And grant your blessings so that the festival of benefit and happiness may flourish.
In short, from now until enlightenment, By never being parted from the joyful, sidelong glance of the Noble Lady, May every desired excellence Be perfectly realized.
Homage to her whose face is like A hundred full autumn moons gathered together, Blazing with the brilliant light Of a thousand gathered stars.

By the power of the two accumulations gathered since beginningless time, You have attained an inconceivable body of space; Because I pray with one-pointed longing, Do not diminish your compassionate blessings, O Jetsunma.
Possessing the auspicious signs of millions of most beautiful emerald particles Gathered into one, May your beautiful form play before my eyes, Radiant with a hundred moods of peaceful smiles.
Seeing such excellent deeds, And aspiring for your qualities, I enter upon the path for the sake of enlightenment; Once again, I take refuge in you.
What need is there to speak of your qualities? Seeing the qualities of your sons, one is overcome; By the brilliance of the rising dawn, One understands the rays of the friend of the lotus.

Possessing the grace of the sixty-four inexhaustible qualities, Of both abandonment and full maturation, You are the Mother who captivates all the Victors and their heirs; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

The human body, impermanent by day and night, moment by moment, Has been attained, yet the great purpose remains unaccomplished; The continuous noose of the Lord of Death, so difficult to turn back, Please sever with the sword of wisdom, O Jetsunma.

Even if the bardo appears for but a fleeting moment, May the emanation and reabsorption of the pure mandala be complete; In the Lotus Array of Great Bliss and other such realms, O Jetsunma, please lead me to a pure land.

May the supreme teachings of the Victor, the source of benefit and happiness, Flourish and spread throughout the ten directions without ever declining, And may the lives of all those sublime great beings who uphold them Be extended for a long time, O Jetsunma.

For the sake of the Victor’s teachings and the happiness of sentient beings, May all the dense thickets of humans and non-humans Who engage in harmful thoughts and actions Be burned by the flames of your power and might, O Jetsunma.

I prostrate, make offerings, and confess, I rejoice, exhort, and pray; Whatever slight virtue I have accumulated, I dedicate it all for the sake of enlightenment.

Svāhā! With clouds of the perfect age of enlightened activity, You let fall a rain of the jewels of virtue and excellence, Granting relief to all beings of the three realms; I prostrate to the Mother, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

For the sake of the Victor’s teachings and the happiness of sentient beings, May all the dense thickets of humans and non-humans Who engage in harmful thoughts and actions Be burned by the flames of your power and might, O Jetsunma.

With the precious vessel of your bodhicitta, O Tāre, From the ocean of suffering in cyclic existence and the lower realms, You constantly liberate all sentient beings, as vast as space; I prostrate to the Noble Mother, Jetsunma Drolma.

Sentient beings of this degenerate age, when the five drosses are rampant, Are bound by the powerful force of afflictions and the shackles of craving. Those who have entered the teachings are driven by the red wind of jealousy; The teachings are agitated from within, and the dregs of degenerate views flourish.

From the ocean of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion, The glory of the blooming lotus of benefit and bliss has arisen; Noble Tārā, possessing the light of nectar, Please pacify these waves of darkness filled with fear.

Upon the tip of the precious stem between the thumb and ring finger, From a lovely lotus that has newly blossomed, You pour forth nectar of every supreme and common kind; Bring delight to my mind, O Jetsunma.

With Tuttāre, the nectar of blessings, You dispel the tormenting heat of fears and decline, And cause the lotus of benefit and happiness to bloom; I prostrate to the Mother, the Protectress from Distress.

You have perfectly accomplished generosity and ethical discipline, And practiced patience and diligence; Having reached the culmination of meditative concentration and wisdom, I prostrate to you, who have perfected the perfections.
Homage to her whose hand is beautifully adorned With a gold and blue water-born lotus, She whose sphere of activity is generosity, diligence, austerity, peace, Patience, and meditative concentration.

This captivating food, endowed with a hundred flavors, Is perfectly prepared and offered with faith to the Victors and their Heirs; Through this, may all these wandering beings Possess great wealth and enjoy the food of meditative concentration.

In short, for the sake of fully perfecting The compassionate resolve and sacred vows of all who possess the ten powers, You perform inconceivable deeds to tame beings, I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.
Alas! O compassionate Protector, Exert the power and might of your sacred vows, Why would you ever be discouraged by the sorrows of these degenerate times?

May the temples be filled with vast clouds of offerings, And the great drum of the sacred Dharma resound loudly. Shattering the skulls of the heretical elephants, May the Buddha’s teachings be victorious in all directions!

As long as the stream of mind is habituated to the evil of self-grasping, For that long, the river of suffering will constantly flow; Therefore, regarding the nature of the aggregates and so forth, Please ignite the lamp of realization, O Jetsunma.

Those who bear the victory banner of saffron robes and the discipline of renunciation, Bodhisattvas who possess genuine, unfeigned altruism, And mantra-holders of the generation and completion stages who maintain their samaya— To those who have become like a painted lamp, You who possess the eye of primordial wisdom, Please look upon us with certainty and protect us with your compassion!
In both India and Tibet, may the precious lamp Of the festival of a later golden age be lit, And may the lotus grove of the Buddha's non-sectarian teachings reach its full bloom.
Homage to Tāre, the swift and heroic; To Tuttāre, she who dispels all fears; To Ture, the liberatress who grants all benefits; To the syllables of Svāhā, I bow to you.
Homage to her who, with the syllables TUTTĀRA and HŪṂ, Fills the realms of desire, the directions, and space, Trampling the seven worlds under her feet, And is able to summon all without exception.

Homage to you who, with the syllables TRAṬ and PHAṬ, Completely shatter the magical wheels of adversaries, Trampling with your right leg drawn in and left extended, Blazing intensely amidst a swirling mass of fire.

Moreover, to the holders of the treasury of profound and vast ripening and liberation, The root and lineage gurus, the Noble Goddess, the Swift One, And the ocean of the Three Roots and Vajra Dharma protectors, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!

Supreme among those who grant rest in infinite realms, With a backdrop of the stainless, full moon, Seated in the indestructible vajra posture, Dwell as the ornament upon the crown of my head, O Jetsunma.

Buddhas, bodhisattvas, śrāvakas, and pratyekabuddhas of the ten directions, Mañjuśrī, Avalokiteśvara, and the Holder of the Vajra, Bodhisattvas such as Maitreya and the rest, The sixteen elders and the seven great successors.

Having attained supreme enlightenment, Your work for the sake of beings is truly wondrous; That you sacrificed your own life Before being freed from the craving of existence makes my hair stand on end.

More distinguished than the thousand buddhas of this fortunate aeon, Noble and wondrous as the uḍumbara flower, You who took hold of this realm during this age of strife, Homage to the Supreme Sage, the Fulfiller of All Aims.

The supreme ornaments of Jambudvīpa and the wondrous great masters, The eighty-four lords of yoga and the rest, And especially the incomparably kind Padmasambhava, Śāntarakṣita, Trisong Detsen, Vairotsana, and Atiśa;
Homage to you, majestic in your supreme joy, Who spread garlands of light as your crown ornament, Who, with the laughter of TUTTĀRE, Bring demons and the world under your power.
Homage to you, whose head is adorned with a crescent moon, Whose every ornament blazes intensely, From whose matted locks Amitābha Constantly radiates a magnificent light.

Throughout every land, asuras and barbarians abound. Through these and similar circumstances, the teachings are being destroyed.
I prostrate with devotion to the Guru and Mañjughoṣa.
Thus, the Guru of beings, of the Śākya lineage, Born from the royal line of the Ikṣvāku, By this praise of the Bhagavan, the Perfect Buddha, May beings swiftly attain omniscience.

Homage to you, whom Indra, Agni, Brahmā, Vāyu, and the various Īśvaras worship, And whom spirits, zombies, gandharvas, And hosts of yakṣas praise from before you.
Homage to you, perfectly endowed with the power of peace Through the arrangement of the three suchnesses; You are the supreme TURE who destroys The hosts of demons, zombies, and yakṣas.

In particular, the profound meaning of the essential definitive truth, May those with the good fortune to hear it have it settle in their ears; May the hosts of gods, nāgas, and yakṣas who delight in this, Raise its status to the very heights of heaven, O Jetsunma.

Your body is the full autumn moon in the center of a lotus, The youthful bloom of vajra-bliss perfectly complete; With an infinite mandala of stainless light, Bestow the enlightened activities of the four rites, O Jetsunma.

With Oṃ, you bestow the wealth of liberation and all that is desired, Through the good fortune of splendor, prosperity, and the like; You benefit both cyclic existence and peace, O Sovereign of the Three Secrets, I prostrate to the Noble Mother, the Supreme Giver.

Of the mundane and the supramundane, The precious treasure of the ocean of accomplishments, Through the attainment of the secret vidyā-mantra, May you bestow benefit and happiness upon the three worlds.
Homage to TURE, the Great Fearful One, Who completely destroys the champions of Mara, Who forms a frowning expression upon your lotus face, And slays all enemies without exception.
Homage to you, blissful, virtuous, and peaceful, Whose very sphere of experience is the peace of nirvāṇa; Perfectly endowed with SVĀHĀ and OṀ, You are the one who destroys great negativity.
Homage to you, perfectly endowed with the power of peace Through the arrangement of the three suchnesses; You are the supreme TURE who destroys The hosts of demons, zombies, and yakṣas.
The Victorious One subdued the hosts of Māra, Defeated all the non-Buddhist extremists, Liberated countless disciples of the Hearers, And gave prophecies to the noble heirs of the Victor.

Except for taking birth in existence through my own intention, May I not wander in cyclic existence by the power of karma; In the presence of the Victorious One of Infinite Life and Light, O Jetsunma, please prophesy my path and guide me forward.

Homage to you, who dwell in the midst of a blazing garland, Like the fire at the end of an eon; With right leg extended and left bent, surrounded by joy, You completely destroy the armies of enemies.
Homage to you, surrounded by intense joy, Who utterly shatters the bodies of enemies; With the ten-syllable mantra arranged on your speech, You are the wisdom-Tara arising from HŪṀ.

Therefore, reaching out your hand of compassion, Please dispel every fear, And grant me the good fortune Of finding relief in a state of supreme bliss.
Homage to you, who dwell in the midst of a blazing garland, Like the fire at the end of an eon; With right leg extended and left bent, surrounded by joy, You completely destroy the armies of enemies.

For us and all beings tormented by our karma, Wherever we dwell, when sickness, weapons, famine, and the like Repeatedly afflict us with countless unwanted sufferings, Please pull us from this mire of misery, O Jetsunma.

Supreme among those who grant rest in infinite realms, With a backdrop of the stainless, full moon, Seated in the indestructible vajra posture, Dwell as the ornament upon the crown of my head, O Jetsunma.
Homage to you, who have the power To summon all the hosts of local guardians, Who, with a vibrating frown and the syllable HŪṀ, Completely liberate from all destitution.

With the precious vessel of your bodhicitta, O Tāre, From the ocean of suffering in cyclic existence and the lower realms, You constantly liberate all sentient beings, as vast as space; I prostrate to the Noble Mother, Jetsunma Drolma.
With the crowns of gods and demigods, Bowing down before your lotus feet, To you who liberate from all misfortune, Mother Tārā, I offer this homage.

May the very name of unhappiness be absent throughout all lands, And may lifespan, merit, and glory flourish, with reverence for the teachings; From the great clouds of the jewel of a golden age of happiness, Let fall a rain of all that is desired, O Jetsunma.

Pacify all adverse conditions for practicing the sublime Dharma, And with the perfect abundance of all favorable conditions— Lifespan, merit, prosperity, intelligence, and compassion— Grant your blessings so that the two benefits may be accomplished.

May the lives of the masters who uphold the teachings be firm, And may the lifespan and merit of the patrons of the teachings increase. May those who harm the teachings be reduced to nothing but their names, And may the victory banner of the teachings be raised in the ten directions!

Because the great accumulation of merit has not preceded this, Though I boast of having entered the gateway of the Victor’s teachings, My trust in the Three Jewels has not been firmly established; Please uproot these karmic obscurations, O Jetsunma.

All the misdeeds, obscurations, faults, and downfalls accumulated since beginningless time, May they be purified and cleansed within this physical support; And until that time, grant me the glory of harmony with the Dharma, And the siddhi of deathless life-empowerment, O Jetsunma.

Proclaiming the Dharma with the profound melody of Brahmā, And teaching the vast, uninterrupted continuity, Sever all the webs of the three obscurations, And grant the relief of the throne of enlightenment, O Jetsunma.
Homage to you, whose head is adorned with a crescent moon, Whose every ornament blazes intensely, From whose matted locks Amitābha Constantly radiates a magnificent light.

Dharmakāya Prajñāpāramitā, Bhagavatī Samantabhadrī, Complete Sambhogakāya Vajravārāhī, Emanation-display, the Venerable Mother Tārā, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!
Homage to the Uṣṇīṣa of the Tathāgatas, She who acts with infinite, complete victory, She who is deeply relied upon by the Victors' heirs, Having attained every single perfection without exception.

Thus, with devotion I prostrate and make this supplication: From the great clouds of your wisdom-vision, perfect and complete, Let the rain of all desired accomplishments fall, And grant your blessings so that the festival of benefit and happiness may flourish.

Having completely abandoned the distractions of the eight worldly concerns of this life, And without obstacles in the forests of the remote wilderness, By condensing the practice into its essence, in this very life, Make this human existence meaningful, O Jetsunma.

In particular, may I and those who depend upon me Never fall under the power of obstacles at any time; And may the pillar of life, firm and enduring, That perfects longevity and practice, be established, O Jetsunma.

The Buddha's teachings of the Vinaya, Sūtra, and Abhidharma, Along with the four great classes of the Secret Mantra Tantras, The ten great pillars of the scriptural lineages in the Land of Snows, And the eight great chariots of the practice lineages, and so forth— Behold how all the systems of the Buddha’s teachings, both Sūtra and Mantra, Have now fallen into a state of extreme decline!

May the minds of the hostile throngs be transformed, And may all aspire to the teachings and engage in the ten virtues. May the Sangha who uphold the teachings pervade the entire world, And may study and practice flourish and spread.

May the supreme teachings of the Victor, the source of benefit and happiness, Flourish and spread throughout the ten directions without ever declining, And may the lives of all those sublime great beings who uphold them Be extended for a long time, O Jetsunma.

From the ocean of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion, The glory of the blooming lotus of benefit and bliss has arisen; Noble Tārā, possessing the light of nectar, Please pacify these waves of darkness filled with fear.

Homage to you, whom Indra, Agni, Brahmā, Vāyu, and the various Īśvaras worship, And whom spirits, zombies, gandharvas, And hosts of yakṣas praise from before you.
Homage to you, perfectly endowed with the power of peace Through the arrangement of the three suchnesses; You are the supreme TURE who destroys The hosts of demons, zombies, and yakṣas.

Homage to all gurus, buddhas, and bodhisattvas.

For us and all beings tormented by our karma, Wherever we dwell, when sickness, weapons, famine, and the like Repeatedly afflict us with countless unwanted sufferings, Please pull us from this mire of misery, O Jetsunma.
Homage to Tāre, the swift and heroic; To Tuttāre, she who dispels all fears; To Ture, the liberatress who grants all benefits; To the syllables of Svāhā, I bow to you.

Mother of all the Victors, medicine that dispels torment, Loving nurse, the sole kinsman of all living beings; Throughout the garland of my lives, I have no other, So I take refuge in you until I reach the heart of enlightenment.

Chokgyur Dechen Lingpa, who opened the door to profound treasures, Dorje Ziji Tsal, endowed with the seven authoritative transmissions, Pema Garwang, who clarified the Buddha’s teachings, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!
Your scriptural speech is a lion’s roar; When proclaimed to the world including the gods, Brahmā and Viṣṇu were rendered speechless, And the teachers of the gods shrank away like foxes.

The Buddha's teachings of the Vinaya, Sūtra, and Abhidharma, Along with the four great classes of the Secret Mantra Tantras, The ten great pillars of the scriptural lineages in the Land of Snows, And the eight great chariots of the practice lineages, and so forth— Behold how all the systems of the Buddha’s teachings, both Sūtra and Mantra, Have now fallen into a state of extreme decline!

May the supreme teachings of the Victor, the source of benefit and happiness, Flourish and spread throughout the ten directions without ever declining, And may the lives of all those sublime great beings who uphold them Be extended for a long time, O Jetsunma.

Pacify all adverse conditions for practicing the sublime Dharma, And with the perfect abundance of all favorable conditions— Lifespan, merit, prosperity, intelligence, and compassion— Grant your blessings so that the two benefits may be accomplished.

May all mothers, vast as space, be free from the fears Of untimely death and the like, and naturally enjoy the glory of the ten virtues; May they accompany the foundation of the Three Jewels’ teachings, And steer the helm of liberation upward, O Jetsunma.

May the minds of the hostile throngs be transformed, And may all aspire to the teachings and engage in the ten virtues. May the Sangha who uphold the teachings pervade the entire world, And may study and practice flourish and spread.
When the protector of beings was first born, All the wise ones of the world rejoiced; The hosts of Māra were filled with great anxiety, And all the non-Buddhist extremists were terrified.
The Victorious One subdued the hosts of Māra, Defeated all the non-Buddhist extremists, Liberated countless disciples of the Hearers, And gave prophecies to the noble heirs of the Victor.

Homage to you who, with the syllables TRAṬ and PHAṬ, Completely shatter the magical wheels of adversaries, Trampling with your right leg drawn in and left extended, Blazing intensely amidst a swirling mass of fire.
Homage to you, who strike the surface of the earth With your palms and trample it with your feet; With a wrathful frown and the syllable HŪṀ, You shatter the seven levels.
Homage to Tāre, the swift and heroic; To Tuttāre, she who dispels all fears; To Ture, the liberatress who grants all benefits; To the syllables of Svāhā, I bow to you.
Homage to Tārā, the swift and heroic, Whose eyes are like a momentary flash of lightning, She who arose from the opening stamens Of the lotus-face of the Lord of the Three Worlds.

Possessing the eye of wisdom, free from the dust of profound insight, And the excellent conduct of one whose afflictions gradually diminish, With great respect for the training, and with mindfulness and vigilance, O Jetsunma, please blend my mind-stream with the Dharma.

Sentient beings of this degenerate age, when the five drosses are rampant, Are bound by the powerful force of afflictions and the shackles of craving. Those who have entered the teachings are driven by the red wind of jealousy; The teachings are agitated from within, and the dregs of degenerate views flourish.

With Oṃ, you bestow the wealth of liberation and all that is desired, Through the good fortune of splendor, prosperity, and the like; You benefit both cyclic existence and peace, O Sovereign of the Three Secrets, I prostrate to the Noble Mother, the Supreme Giver.

Your heart-mind is the expanse of non-dual primordial wisdom; Though you have withdrawn the engagement and emergence of conceptual elaborations, You possess boundless splendor of awareness and love; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Beneath the sovereign Bodhi tree, you pervaded the earth and sky, subduing the hosts of Māra, Who rained down a shower of vajras, short spears, wheels, fire, mountains, and ranges of snow-peaks. When the powerful one, adorned with flower-arrows, strove to obstruct your enlightenment through miraculous displays, You defeated them well with a heart of loving-kindness; I bow my head to you, the one who attained perfect Buddhahood.

In all my lifetimes, may I meet a spiritual friend who is not mistaken, And through them understand all the teachings; From now until enlightenment, O Jetsunma, please destroy The demonic forces that obstruct my life and liberation.

Even when I see that the fruits of karma are ripening before my eyes, I still have not developed faith in karma and its results; Like a beast of prey in saffron robes, Please lead my mind toward virtue, O Jetsunma.

Homage to her who, with the syllables TUTTĀRA and HŪṂ, Fills the realms of desire, the directions, and space, Trampling the seven worlds under her feet, And is able to summon all without exception.
Homage to you, who have the power To summon all the hosts of local guardians, Who, with a vibrating frown and the syllable HŪṀ, Completely liberate from all destitution.
Possessing the auspicious signs of millions of most beautiful emerald particles Gathered into one, May your beautiful form play before my eyes, Radiant with a hundred moods of peaceful smiles.
Homage to you, who strike the surface of the earth With your palms and trample it with your feet; With a wrathful frown and the syllable HŪṀ, You shatter the seven levels.

By the power of the two accumulations gathered since beginningless time, You have attained an inconceivable body of space; Because I pray with one-pointed longing, Do not diminish your compassionate blessings, O Jetsunma.
Homage to you, the sovereign of the hosts of gods, Served by gods and kinnaras; With the majesty of your armor of universal joy, You dispel strife and bad dreams.

In short, since you are the essence of refuge, Until I attain enlightenment, always Do not let me fall under the power of obstructing demons, But grant your grace to perfect the twofold benefit.
Your son is Mañjughoṣa, Your disciple is Śāradvatīputra, You have made Maitreya your supreme regent; Who could possibly doubt this?
